name: Caroba Plastics Inc
old_description: Caroba Plastics offers engineering assistance and support from the earliest stages of product design.
about:
Caroba Plastics Inc is headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, in the Denver metropolitan area. The company was founded in 1983 by Barry Hart as a small, family-owned operation with two injection molding machines and a vision to provide high-quality plastic parts. Hart remains the owner and drives a hands-on philosophy emphasizing clean, organized facilities, systematic processes, and personal attention.

Today Caroba operates a fleet of 30 Nissei high-precision injection molding presses ranging from 20 to 750 tons, supported by in-house tooling design, maintenance, and repair. The facility includes an ISO Class 7 hard-wall cleanroom for medical molding and contract assembly, over 60,000 square feet of warehousing with lot and location control, and secondary operations such as assembly, packaging, and automated part removal. The company employs over 150 people and offers DFM assistance, mold validation, and ship-to-stock programs.

Caroba serves the medical, dental, high-technology, semiconductor, and consumer industries. It holds certified "dock-to-stock" status for medical OEMs and semiconductor customers, and its quality system supports IQ/OQ/PQ validation, measurement system analysis, and process capability studies. The management team brings over 100 years of combined thermoplastic experience.

The company's differentiation stems from its founding principles: a clean, organized plant; systematic processes; honesty; and hard work. Project teams of engineers, toolmakers, and polymer experts engage from design inception to reduce errors and cost. Caroba has maintained ISO 9001:2015 certification since 1998 and operates with a "do it right the first time" attitude.

name: Carolina Precision Switchgear
old_description: Carolina Precision Switchgear specializes in refurbishing low and medium voltage circuit breakers restoring the equipment back to pristine condition.
about:
Carolina Precision Switchgear operates from Concord, North Carolina, in the Charlotte metropolitan area. The company was founded in 2006 by Doug Weaver, a former U.S. Navy interior communications specialist who spent 24 years as a nuclear supervisor at Duke Energy performing power-factor testing and circuit-breaker repair. Weaver launched the business to provide specialized refurbishing and testing services for low- and medium-voltage switchgear.

The firm’s core work is restoring circuit breakers to original performance through a full disassembly, cleaning, plating (silver or dichromate), repair, and reassembly process carried out by Level II PEARL‑certified technicians. A 10,000‑square‑foot facility houses calibrated test equipment including primary‑injection sets, while mobile trailers bring the same capabilities to customer sites. Through its affiliation with Group CBS, the company also offers engineering support, training, and access to over 800 CBS ArcSafe remote‑racking and remote‑switching products.

Customers span utilities, manufacturing plants, and commercial facilities. The shop services equipment from major manufacturers such as ABB, GE, Westinghouse/Eaton, Siemens, Square D, and Federal Pacific, as well as obsolete brands. Services range from preventive maintenance and infrared thermography to arc‑flash studies, high‑current testing, cable VLF/tan‑delta testing, and emergency troubleshooting.

The company emphasizes that reconditioning existing breakers can cost roughly 30 % of a new retrofill installation, saving customers tens of thousands of dollars. Its differentiation rests on the combination of in‑shop and on‑site capabilities, PEARL‑certified personnel, and the parts inventory and remote‑operation tools supplied by the Group CBS network.

name: Carriage Hill Craft Metals
old_description: Carriage Hill Craft Metals is Proud to Have Acquired Port Sheet Metal
about:
Carriage Hill Craft Metals operates from Georgetown, Massachusetts, on the North Shore. The company was founded in 2018 by Chris Breen, a Rowley native who graduated from Whittier Regional Vocational Technical High School in 2008 and spent the next decade honing his metal fabrication skills before launching his own shop. Breen formed the business as a limited liability company after acquiring Port Sheet Metal, a local firm with a 40-year service history.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including shearing, braking, punching, band-saw cutting, MIG and TIG welding, grinding, and soldering. Equipment includes an automated single-turret Strip-It 18/30 punch capable of 1/4-inch plate, an apron brake that bends 14-gauge steel up to 10 feet, horizontal and vertical band saws that handle material up to 12-inch plate, and shearing capacity for 12-ounce copper through 11-gauge steel and 3/16-inch aluminum up to 8 feet long. Typical output ranges from copper countertops, bar tops, and artistic grindings to structural steel brackets, fireplace dampers, shower pans, flashing, and cupolas.

Customers include residential, commercial, and architectural clients across the North Shore region, with projects such as a Newburyport railing installation exceeding 150 feet and a Corten steel deck on the Newburyport riverfront. The company also serves contractors and designers seeking custom metalwork for building and renovation projects.

Breen started the business to apply his creativity and technical knowledge on his own terms, emphasizing the continuity of Port Sheet Metal's long-standing quality standards.

name: Cascade Solar
old_description: We provide expert installation, custom system design, and trusted support for homes and businesses.
about:
Cascade Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Portland, Oregon. Founded by Tom Crowe and David Nicholls out of a personal commitment to solar energy, the business began after Crowe managed over 500 residential installations at a large regional solar firm and Nicholls brought more than a decade of experience as an electrician in the solar industry. The pair started the company together with the intention of staying small and growing at a sustainable pace.

The company provides custom solar system design, permitting, installation, activation, and ongoing maintenance for homes and businesses. Services include battery backup installation using equipment from FranklinWH, Tesla Powerwall, Enphase, and Sol-Ark, as well as real-time monitoring with production alerts and fault detection. Routine maintenance covers physical inspections, hardware checks, wiring, and performance reviews, all supported by a 10-year workmanship warranty.

Cascade Solar serves residential homeowners, commercial property owners, and multi-unit residential communities, including affordable housing projects. Notable projects include a 30 kW solar-plus-battery system for a complex Portland roof and a green apartment community installation. The company also offers financing guidance, incentive consultation, and personalized system sizing.

The founders emphasize honest pricing, quality craftsmanship, and a neighborly approach, encouraging customers to compare quotes. Their differentiation rests on a 10-year workmanship warranty, a commitment to never sacrifice core values for growth, and a focus on transparent, stress-free service from consultation through activation.

Its factory-authorized, CFESA-certified technicians provide 24/7 emergency repairs, preventative maintenance programs, warranty administration, and equipment installation for a wide range of cooking and refrigeration equipment including convection ovens, griddles, charbroilers, combi ovens, steamers, kettles, tilt skillets, fryers, pizza ovens, dishwashers, and toasters.

Casco serves the foodservice and restaurant industries, supporting commercial kitchens throughout New England with same-day repair capability and ongoing maintenance contracts.

The company distinguishes itself with the highest first-call fix rate in New England, round-the-clock technician availability, and its status as a factory-authorized service agent ensuring proper warranty protection for customers.

name: Cass County Electric Cooperative
old_description: Stay safe around overhead lines this season — Click here to learn how to protect yourself and your equipment.
about:
Cass County Electric Cooperative is headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota, and has operated as a member-owned electric cooperative since 1937. The organization was formed to bring reliable electricity to rural communities in southeastern North Dakota and remains owned by the members it serves.

The cooperative distributes electricity across a service territory that spans 10 counties, maintaining nearly 6,000 miles of distribution line and 41 substations. It provides power to nearly 61,000 members, including residential, commercial, agricultural, and apartment accounts. Beyond delivery, the cooperative offers member services such as outage monitoring, bill payment, service start/stop/transfer, energy conservation programs, and safety education.

Its customer base includes residential urban and farm accounts, commercial businesses, irrigation operations, and lighting services. The cooperative also supports the broader community through programs like Operation Round Up, which funds local organizations, scholarships and youth programs, and partnerships with community events across its service area.

The cooperative distinguishes itself through its not-for-profit, member-governed structure. A locally elected board of directors sets policy, and the organization emphasizes safety, integrity, innovation, accountability, and community investment as core values. Profits are returned to members as capital credits, and decisions are made with long-term community benefit in mind.
